name: Room-shape meter
summary: Hearing a room's volume from its mode count with a laptop's own speaker and mic. Stages 2, 5, 7 and 9 are built and run; the rest are on paper.

inputs: wall audit: 'you need a tape measure (or lidar) to know a room's size'
outputs: Weyl's law with the rigid-wall corrections, the Sabine cross-check, and the assumptions

gate.condition: every assumption names a check that can fail

tools.name: ATLAS.json
tools.role: source of the law and the wall

tools.name: CHECKS.json
tools.role: named check techniques the stage uses

law.name: Weyl's law for the Neumann Laplacian, with surface and edge terms
law.lineage: Weyl (1911); rectangular-room corrections, Morse and Bolt (1944); Kac, 'Can one hear the shape of a drum?' (1966); Sabine (1900) for T60 = 0.161 V / A

spec.quantity: room volume V (and surface S, weakly)
spec.signal: the count of resolved acoustic modes below f
spec.inversion: fit V and kappa = S / V^(2/3) to the counted modes, corrected for the modes the estimator cannot split

wall_assumptions.assumption: walls are rigid enough that modes are Neumann modes
wall_assumptions.how_checked: measured mode decay times are long (T60 above 0.3 s at low frequency)
wall_assumptions.if_broken: the surface term changes sign or vanishes; V biased

wall_assumptions.assumption: the source and the mic see every mode
wall_assumptions.how_checked: corner to opposite-corner protocol; corners are antinodes of every mode
wall_assumptions.if_broken: undercount; a mid-room mic misses about half

wall_assumptions.how_checked: known-answer injection with two modes 1 Hz apart (R1)
wall_assumptions.if_broken: undercount; this is the wall the matrix pencil attacks

wall_assumptions.assumption: mode spacing is Poisson (a box is integrable; Berry and Tabor 1977)
wall_assumptions.how_checked: the corrected count against the twin's truth
wall_assumptions.if_broken: the resolving correction is wrong for chaotic (irregular) rooms, whose spacings repel

wall_assumptions.assumption: the laptop records raw audio (no automatic gain, noise suppression or echo cancellation)
wall_assumptions.how_checked: electrical or acoustic loopback reads a flat, linear response
wall_assumptions.if_broken: the decay and the spectrum are rewritten by DSP; UNCAL

spec.fundamental_bound: modes merge when their spacing falls below the resolving width; the Schroeder frequency 2000 sqrt(T60 / V) marks where counting ends for any method

stages.does_not_prove: Weyl's law gives the volume of the space the sound fills, which in a furnished room is less than the tape-measured box.

outputs: room/modes.py, chain.py, meter.py, pencil.py, trial.py: a seeded twin of room, chain and estimator

gate.condition: the preregistered kill condition: median laptop volume error below 0.25

spec.model: rigid shoebox, every mode below 900 Hz, log-normal mode damping; 10 s exponential sweep; 16-bit DAC; speaker as a 2nd-order high-pass plus 2nd and 3rd harmonic distortion; red room noise and mic self-noise; MEMS sensitivity; 16-bit ADC at the 48 kHz noise density; regularised Farina deconvolution

noise_sources.name: mic self-noise
noise_sources.value: 29 dB SPL (a MEMS-class figure, from memory, moderate)

noise_sources.name: quantisation
noise_sources.formula: q / sqrt(12) at 16 bits, density of a 48 kHz converter

noise_sources.name: speaker distortion
noise_sources.value: pushed to negative time by the sweep method

bounds.name: modal bandwidth
bounds.value: 2.4 to 7 Hz for T60 0.3 to 0.9 s

bounds.name: Schroeder frequency
bounds.value: about 150 to 400 Hz for these rooms

bounds.name: speaker roll-off
bounds.value: fc 20, 150, 400 Hz for ideal, laptop, phone

known_answer_tests.name: electrical loopback (R0)
known_answer_tests.truth: loopback gain times a unit impulse

known_answer_tests.name: six planted modes, two 1 Hz apart (R1)
real-recording path, WAV files only
known_answer_tests.truth: the same six planted modes at 48 kHz

stages.does_not_prove: The twin is a rigid shoebox with an ideal corner protocol; furniture, open doors, irregular plans and real laptop DSP are absent.
stages.notes: Preregistered run 20261031T003606Z: V1 PASS, V2 FAIL, V3 PASS, V4 FAIL, V5 FAIL, V6 PASS, V7 PASS. Laptop median errors: naive Fourier count 0.74, corrected Fourier 0.44, matrix pencil 0.14, shoebox prior 0.24, prior guess 0.32. A known-answer test of the WAV path then found a circular-filter bug in the T60 step (deviation D1). Post hoc run 20261031T004139Z with the fix: V2 PASS, V4 PASS, V5 FAIL; laptop pencil median 0.16, gap to the prior guess 0.23 (CI 0.14 to 0.32).

inputs: the laptop or phone in hand
outputs: a device profile: speaker roll-off, mic response, raw-capture mode, ADC format

gate.condition: the device profile is measured, not assumed: loopback flat within 1 dB over 40 to 150 Hz after the speaker correction

tools.name: any recorder that writes 16-bit PCM WAV with effects off (Audacity, for example)

chain.key_spec: low-frequency corner near 150 Hz in the twin; measure it

chain.part_or_device: built-in MEMS mic, or a phone as the mic

chain.key_spec: no resampling in the capture path

noise_budget.share_of_total: dominant in a very quiet room
negligible after the 10 s sweep's processing gain

spec.margin_to_bound: the round trip keeps 8.4 of 18.3 bits per bin in 40 to 150 Hz; the estimator, not the converter, sets the error

stages.does_not_prove: A measured profile holds for one device in one mode; an OS update can switch DSP back on.

outputs: no board; a recorded device identity instead

gate.condition: the device identity (model, OS build, audio driver, capture settings) is recorded in every receipt

tools.name: every-dimension bus.py
tools.role: receipt events on the measurement bus

checks: device model and OS build logged
capture app and its effect settings logged
spec.spend: gated: nothing ordered, priced or fabricated

stages.does_not_prove: A logged identity does not prove two units of one model behave alike.

outputs: host analysis code, hashed into every receipt

gate.condition: the code hash in a receipt matches the code that ran; the WAV known-answer test passes

tools.name: CHECKS.json
tools.role: named check techniques the stage uses

spec.platform: host Python on the laptop; the device only plays and records

toolchain.name: Python 3.12, NumPy 2.4
toolchain.pinned: versions recorded; code sha256 in each receipt (receipt.code_sha256)

reproducible_build.method: no build: the analysis is source; the hash is over the seven source files
reproducible_build.check: rerun on the same WAV gives the same receipt value

self_tests.name: auto-zero (silence capture)
self_tests.method: record 1 s of silence before the sweep; it sets the noise spectrum

self_tests.name: loopback
self_tests.method: headphone-out to mic-in cable where the device has both; else the speaker held to the mic

self_tests.name: known-signal injection
self_tests.method: the planted six-mode recording through the real WAV path
self_tests.pass_condition: each mode within 0.05 Hz, decay within 5 percent

self_tests.name: UNCAL
self_tests.method: no calibration record, or a failed self-test, flags the receipt
self_tests.pass_condition: the simulated receipt carries UNCAL (it does)

stages.does_not_prove: The known-answer test checks the code path, not the room.

outputs: a per-device correction and a calibration record

gate.condition: on 5 tape-measured rooms the device's median volume error is within the twin's laptop spread

tools.name: CHECKS.json
tools.role: named check techniques the stage uses

spec.method: substitution against tape-measured rooms (the known answer), plus a closet or bathroom as a small room; the Sabine absorption from the fit is reported beside each

references.name: steel tape measure
references.traceability: class II tape (from memory, moderate); not checked against anything here

spec.honest_traceability: No primary standard exists for room volume by sound; the reference is a tape measure of unknown calibration, and a furnished room's air volume differs from its box. Receipts stay UNCAL until this record exists.

stages.does_not_prove: Five rooms say little about rooms unlike them.

outputs: the round trip scored: error against truth and bits lost per path

gate.condition: loopback error below -60 dB, planted modes within 0.2 Hz, every full-chain error below -20 dB

tools.name: CHECKS.json
tools.role: named check techniques the stage uses

spec.rig: software round trip, simulated first: digital sweep, DAC, speaker, air (the room), mic, ADC, deconvolution; the physical rig is the device itself with a loopback cable

signals.name: R2 six random rooms
signals.truth: the twin's noise-free chain impulse response

scoring.error_vs_truth: normalised squared transfer error in 40 to 150 Hz, truth passed through the same measurement operator (new check operatortruth)
scoring.bits_lost: 1/2 log2(1 + |H|^2 / |H_est - H|^2) per bin, ideal digital path minus each path

stages.does_not_prove: A twin round trip checks the method against the twin's own physics; a real room can break assumptions the twin shares with the estimator.

outputs: volume readings in real rooms under a preregistered protocol

gate.condition: in 10 tape-measured rooms, the median error is below 0.25 and beats the prior guess

sites: the author's own rooms, empty and furnished
a closet and a bathroom (small, hard walls)
the space under a large tree's canopy as an open-field null (no modes expected)

protocol.prereg: a studyrun spec locked before the first field recording (not written yet)
protocol.kill_condition: median field error above 0.25, or no better than the prior guess
controls: mid-room mic placement, which the theory says undercounts

stages.does_not_prove: Ten rooms in one house share a builder, materials and style.
